supporting_quotes.exact: A B-Tree is a specialized m-way tree designed to optimize data access, especially on disk-based storage systems.
In a B-Tree of order m, each node can have up to m children and m-1 keys, allowing it to efficiently manage large datasets.
The value of m is decided based on disk block and key sizes.

observations.subject: B-Tree
observations.object: specialized m-way tree designed to optimize data access, especially disk-based storage

observations.subject: B-Tree of order m
observations.object: up to m children and m-1 keys

claims.rationale: 三条引文逐一支撑 claim 的分句：evidence-66214b606544[0,112) 声明 B 树是特化的 m 路树、为优化数据访问而设计、尤其面向磁盘存储系统；evidence-8ae77e263dd5[0,123) 声明 m 阶 B 树每节点至多 m 个孩子、m-1 个键；evidence-9816f0e07ebc[0,60) 声明 m 的取值由磁盘块与键大小决定。引文与 claim 各分句一一对应，无超范围或矛盾内容。注：全部证据来自同一 source（provenance 为空），无可引证的跨源独立性，verdict 基于该单一来源。

supporting_quotes.exact: One of the standout features of a B-Tree is its ability to store a significant number of keys within a single node, including large key values.
It significantly reduces the tree’s height, hence reducing costly disk operations.

observations.subject: B-Tree node
observations.object: a significant number of keys including large key values

observations.subject: B-Tree
observations.object: tree height, hence costly disk operations

claims.rationale: evidence-b1b915105f64[0,143) 声明 B 树单节点可存储大量键（包括大键值），对应 claim 第一分句；evidence-d8f1cb6c82c0[0,82) 声明这显著降低树高、从而减少高代价磁盘操作，对应 claim 的因果推断。两段引文语义叠加完整支撑 claim，无未覆盖或矛盾内容。注：证据均来自同一 source，无跨源独立性证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: - All leaf nodes of a B tree are at the same level, i.e. they have the same depth (height of the tree).
- The keys of each node of a B tree (in case of multiple keys), should be stored in the ascending order.
- In a B tree , all non-leaf nodes (except root node) should have at leastm/2 children.
- All nodes (except root node) should have at least m/2 - 1 keys.
A non-leaf node with n-1 key values should have n non NULL children.

observations.subject: all leaf nodes of a B tree
observations.object: the same level (same depth, i.e. tree height)

observations.subject: non-leaf node with n-1 key values

claims.rationale: 五条引文与 claim 列出的五条性质逐一对应：evidence-76dc09ac3b6d[0,103) 叶节点同层同深度；evidence-64ae9b2b952f[0,104) 节点内键升序存储；evidence-929c66dfcdfe[0,87) 非叶节点（除根）至少 m/2 个孩子（引文原文 'leastm/2' 为源文排版，语义无歧义）；evidence-00006726c56b[0,65) 所有节点（除根）至少 m/2-1 个键；evidence-c030dbd0c441[0,68) 具 n-1 键的非叶节点应有 n 个非空孩子。全部匹配，无冲突。注：证据均来自同一 source，无跨源独立性证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: While M-way trees can be either balanced or skewed, B-Trees are always self-balanced.

observations.subject: M-way trees vs B-Trees
observations.object: M-way can be balanced or skewed; B-Trees are always self-balanced

claims.rationale: evidence-a2c2600534ba[0,85) 直接陈述 M 路树可平衡可倾斜、而 B 树总是自平衡，与 claim 完全一致，无超范围或矛盾内容。注：单一来源，无跨源独立性证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: Search is similar to the search in Binary Search Tree.
Start from the root and recursively traverse down.

claims.rationale: evidence-c36ad82f4456[0,54) 声明 B 树查找与二叉搜索树查找类似；evidence-6c2e5c8c86d0[0,50) 声明从根开始递归向下遍历。两段引文共同覆盖 claim 的相似性与遍历方式两个层面，无未覆盖或矛盾内容。注：证据均来自同一 source，无跨源独立性证据。

With the indexing feature, multilevel indexing can be achieved.
Most of the servers also use the B-tree approach.
B-Trees are used in CAD systems to organize and search geometric data.

observations.object: large databases to access data stored on disk

observations.subject: B-Trees
observations.object: CAD systems to organize and search geometric data

claims.rationale: 四条引文与 claim 四个分句逐一对应：evidence-8214458f5d1a[0,63) 大型数据库访问磁盘数据；evidence-2759f2b8a2fa[0,63) 借助索引特性实现多级索引；evidence-b73b4224b61e[0,49) 多数服务器采用 B 树方案；evidence-1c09cbbe9339[0,70) CAD 系统组织与检索几何数据。均被引文直接支持，无矛盾。注：证据均来自同一 source，无跨源独立性证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: B-Trees have a guaranteed time complexity of O(log n) for basic operations like insertion, deletion, and searching, which makes them suitable for large data sets and real-time applications.
B-Trees are self-balancing.
High-concurrency and high-throughput.
Efficient storage utilization.

observations.object: guaranteed O(log n) time complexity for insertion/deletion/searching; suitable for large data sets and real-time applications

claims.rationale: 四条引文与 claim 各分句对应：evidence-5363f1317e57[0,190) 基本操作（插入/删除/查找）有保证的 O(log n) 复杂度，适合大数据集与实时应用；evidence-106c338287c4[0,27) 自平衡；evidence-2f0c8558da51[0,37) 高并发高吞吐；evidence-8c0c9f65c122[0,30) 存储利用率高。全部被引文直接支持，无超范围或矛盾内容。注：证据均来自同一 source，无跨源独立性证据。

Not the best for all cases.
